description.value: Impact-dispersing internal cage. Reduce falling and forced-movement collision damage by 5. Not knocked prone by an effect unless it also deals damage.

cinderfall.incomplete: Reducing falling/forced-movement collision damage by a flat 5 has no matching selector: as with Kinetic-Lattice, pf2e has no damage type or roll option distinguishing fall/collision damage from ordinary bludgeoning, so a flat Resistance would incorrectly also blunt ordinary attacks. 'Not knocked prone unless the effect also deals damage' has no hook: no rule element conditions prone-immunity on whether the triggering effect happened to deal damage.
